<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en-GB">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>The Operational Audit — Flow & Structure Co.</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,400;0,9..144,500;0,9..144,600;1,9..144,400&family=Hanken+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#1F1F22; --teal:#1F1F22; --cream:#F4F4F5; --white:#FFFFFF; --grey:#3A3A3A;
    --teal-soft:#E4EAEA; --line:rgba(40,40,46,.12);
    --irid:linear-gradient(135deg,#d2eaea 0%,#dcd9ee 35%,#ece3ec 65%,#d2eae6 100%);
    --serif:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif; --sans:'Hanken Grotesk',system-ui,sans-serif;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
  body{
    font-family:var(--sans); color:var(--grey); line-height:1.6;
    background:var(--cream);
    background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 12% 8%,rgba(168,216,216,.22),transparent 40%),
                     radial-gradient(circle at 88% 92%,rgba(192,192,216,.22),transparent 44%);
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; min-height:100vh;
  }
  .wrap{max-width:680px;margin:0 auto;padding:48px 24px 80px}
  .brandlogo{display:block;width:128px;height:128px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:16px;margin:0 auto 22px;box-shadow:0 16px 38px -20px rgba(27,58,92,.45)}
  .card{
    background:var(--white); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:18px;
    padding:44px 40px; box-shadow:0 24px 60px -28px rgba(27,58,92,.30);
  }
  .eyebrow{font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:18px}
  h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:2.5rem;line-height:1.08;color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:-.01em}
  h1 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--teal)}
  h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:1.7rem;color:var(--navy);line-height:1.15}
  .lede{font-size:1.08rem;margin-top:18px;color:#4a4a4a}
  .meta{display:flex;gap:26px;margin-top:30px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
  .meta div{font-size:.86rem}
  .meta strong{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--navy);font-weight:500}
  .btn{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;border:none;
    font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;
    background:var(--navy);color:var(--white);padding:15px 30px;border-radius:999px;
    transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease; margin-top:34px;
  }
  .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 28px -12px rgba(27,58,92,.5)}
  .btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--navy);border:1.5px solid var(--line);box-shadow:none}
  .btn.ghost:hover{border-color:var(--teal);box-shadow:none}
  .btn[disabled]{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;box-shadow:none}
  .arrow{font-size:1.15em;line-height:1}
  /* progress */
  .progress{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:30px}
  .bar{flex:1;height:6px;background:var(--teal-soft);border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden}
  .bar span{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--irid);border-radius:999px;transition:width .4s ease}
  .bar span::after{content:"";display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(42,127,127,.5));}
  .step-label{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--teal);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
  .sec-name{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--navy)}
  /* questions */
  .q{padding:22px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .q:last-child{border-bottom:none}
  .q p{font-size:1.04rem;color:var(--navy);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:14px}
  .scale{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:8px}
  .scale label{position:relative;cursor:pointer}
  .scale input{position:absolute;opacity:0;inset:0;cursor:pointer}
  .scale .opt{
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 4px;text-align:center;
    font-size:.7rem;color:#8a8a8a;transition:all .15s ease;min-height:62px;font-weight:500;
  }
  .scale .opt b{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--navy);font-weight:500}
  .scale label:hover .opt{border-color:var(--teal)}
  .scale input:checked + .opt{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
  .scale input:checked + .opt b{color:var(--white)}
  /* results */
  .ring-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;margin:8px 0 10px}
  .ring{position:relative;width:200px;height:200px}
  .ring svg{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
  .ring .num{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .ring .num b{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:3.2rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--navy);line-height:1}
  .ring .num small{font-size:.85rem;color:#8a8a8a;letter-spacing:.04em}
  .band{text-align:center;margin-top:6px}
  .band .tag{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:2rem;color:var(--teal)}
  .verdict{margin-top:22px;font-size:1.05rem;color:#4a4a4a}
  .breakdown{margin-top:34px}
  .breakdown h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;color:var(--navy);font-size:1.25rem;margin-bottom:18px}
  .row{margin-bottom:16px}
  .row .top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:6px}
  .row .top .n{color:var(--navy);font-weight:600}
  .row .top .v{color:#8a8a8a;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
  .track{height:9px;background:var(--teal-soft);border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden}
  .track span{display:block;height:100%;width:0;border-radius:999px;transition:width .8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
  .row.weak .n::after{content:" — your softest spot";color:var(--teal);font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-family:var(--serif)}
  .callout{background:var(--cream);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:3px solid var(--teal);border-radius:12px;padding:22px 24px;margin-top:32px}
  .callout p{font-size:1rem;color:var(--navy)}
  .field{margin-top:24px}
  .field label{display:block;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:8px}
  .field input{width:100%;padding:14px 16px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:1rem;color:var(--navy)}
  .field input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--teal)}
  .field small{display:block;margin-top:8px;color:#9a9a9a;font-size:.8rem}
  .foot{text-align:center;margin-top:40px;font-size:.78rem;color:#a5a5a5}
  .foot span{color:var(--teal)}
  .hidden{display:none}
  .fade{animation:fade .5s ease both}
  @keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
  @media(max-width:560px){
    .card{padding:32px 22px} h1{font-size:2rem}
    .scale{gap:5px} .scale .opt{font-size:.6rem;padding:8px 2px}
    .ring{width:170px;height:170px} .ring .num b{font-size:2.7rem}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">

  <!-- INTRO -->
  <section id="intro" class="card fade" style="text-align:center">
    <img class="brandlogo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Flow & Structure Co.">
    <div class="eyebrow">Flow &amp; Structure Co.</div>
    <h1>The <em>Operational Audit</em></h1>
    <p class="lede">Most businesses don't break. They just become harder to run. This is a quick, honest look at how much of yours is held together by structure — and how much is held together by you.</p>
    <div class="meta">
      <div><strong>8</strong>sections</div>
      <div><strong>40</strong>statements</div>
      <div><strong>≈6</strong>minutes</div>
    </div>
    <button class="btn" onclick="start()">Start the audit <span class="arrow">→</span></button>
    <p class="foot" style="text-align:left;margin-top:28px">No login. No jargon. Just a score out of 200 and a fairly honest mirror.</p>
  </section>

  <!-- QUIZ -->
  <section id="quiz" class="card hidden">
    <div class="progress">
      <div class="step-label" id="stepLabel">Section 1 of 8</div>
      <div class="bar"><span id="barFill"></span></div>
    </div>
    <h2 class="sec-title"></h2>
    <p class="lede sec-blurb" style="margin-top:10px;margin-bottom:8px"></p>
    <div id="questions"></div>
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px">
      <button class="btn ghost" id="backBtn" onclick="back()" style="margin-top:30px">← Back</button>
      <button class="btn" id="nextBtn" onclick="next()" disabled>Next →</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- RESULTS -->
  <section id="results" class="card hidden">
    <img class="brandlogo" style="width:84px;height:84px;margin-bottom:14px" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Flow & Structure Co.">
    <div class="eyebrow">Your result</div>
    <div class="ring-wrap">
      <div class="ring">
        <svg width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200">
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id="g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8FCDCD"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#B6B0DA"/>
            </linearGradient>
          </defs>
          <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="86" fill="none" stroke="#E4EAEA" stroke-width="16"/>
          <circle id="ringFill" cx="100" cy="100" r="86" fill="none" stroke="url(#g)" stroke-width="16"
                  stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="540" stroke-dashoffset="540"/>
        </svg>
        <div class="num"><b id="scoreNum">0</b><small>out of 200</small></div>
      </div>
      <div class="band"><span class="tag" id="bandTag"></span></div>
    </div>
    <p class="verdict" id="verdict"></p>

    <div class="breakdown">
      <h3>Where it's solid, where it's holding on</h3>
      <div id="rows"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="callout"><p id="weakNote"></p></div>

    <!-- EMAIL CAPTURE — sends to your Google Sheet (see guide) -->
    <div class="field" id="emailField">
      <label for="email">Want a copy of your result and the breakdown?</label>
      <input type="email" id="email" placeholder="you@yourbusiness.co.uk" autocomplete="email">
      <button class="btn" id="sendBtn" style="margin-top:14px" onclick="submitLead()">Email me my result</button>
      <small id="emailMsg">Pop your email in and I'll send it over, plus the occasional note on the unglamorous side of running a business. No spam, easy unsubscribe.</small>
    </div>

    <a class="btn" id="ctaBtn" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Book a discovery call <span class="arrow">→</span></a>
    <button class="btn ghost" onclick="restart()">Start again</button>

    <p class="foot">Built by <span>Flow &amp; Structure Co.</span> — operational support for owner-led businesses across Cumbria &amp; beyond.</p>
  </section>

</div>

<script>
/* ============================================================
   CONFIG — edit these TWO links when you deploy (see the guide)
   ============================================================ */
const DISCOVERY_CALL_URL = "https://flowandstructureco.com";   // <-- 1. your discovery-call / booking link
const LEAD_ENDPOINT       = "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwUdRvFE_tD9ODXy89Dltd39xrzPUfEj7KzLRy4Ixi7eKo84XqfBopbILsiqyekMAXC/exec";                                 // <-- 2. paste your Google Sheet web-app URL here

// Sends the completed result to your Google Sheet (email, score, weakest area, date).
// If LEAD_ENDPOINT is left blank, the audit still works — it just won't collect the lead.
function sendLead(payload){
  if(!LEAD_ENDPOINT) return Promise.resolve();          // not wired up yet — do nothing
  return fetch(LEAD_ENDPOINT, {
    method:"POST", mode:"no-cors",
    headers:{"Content-Type":"text/plain;charset=utf-8"}, // text/plain avoids a CORS preflight
    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
  });
}

/* ============================================================
   AUDIT CONTENT
   ============================================================ */
const SECTIONS = [
  { name:"Founder dependency",
    blurb:"How much of the business runs through you, personally.",
    q:[ "The business can keep moving for several days without me being reachable.",
        "Day-to-day decisions don't all need my sign-off.",
        "If I'm ill or away, work doesn't stall waiting for me.",
        "I'm not the only person who can do any one critical task.",
        "I could take a proper holiday without checking in constantly." ] },
  { name:"Processes & documentation",
    blurb:"Whether the 'how' lives in a document or just in someone's head.",
    q:[ "Our key processes are written down, not only known.",
        "A new person could follow how we work from what's documented.",
        "The same task tends to get done the same way each time.",
        "When something changes, we update the written version.",
        "I rarely have to re-explain the same process from scratch." ] },
  { name:"Service & client delivery",
    blurb:"How consistent the experience is, whoever's handling it.",
    q:[ "Every client gets a consistent experience, regardless of who's on it.",
        "Bringing on a new client follows a clear, repeatable path.",
        "Important things don't fall through the cracks between stages.",
        "We're clear on what 'done' looks like for each piece of work.",
        "Handovers between people (or back to me) go smoothly." ] },
  { name:"Systems & tools",
    blurb:"Whether your tools do the work, or just sit there making you feel guilty.",
    q:[ "Our tools genuinely reduce work rather than create more.",
        "Information lives in a system, not scattered across inboxes and heads.",
        "We're not re-entering the same information in several places.",
        "The team knows which tool to use for what.",
        "Our setup could cope if the workload doubled." ] },
  { name:"Financial operations",
    blurb:"Invoicing, cashflow, and the small matter of actually getting paid.",
    q:[ "Invoices go out promptly and consistently.",
        "I always know what's owed and what's overdue.",
        "Cashflow rarely catches me by surprise.",
        "Getting paid doesn't depend on me chasing manually every time.",
        "Money admin doesn't eat into delivery time." ] },
  { name:"Communication & handover",
    blurb:"How information moves — and whether you're the relay station.",
    q:[ "The team can find what they need without coming through me.",
        "Information flows without me having to pass it along.",
        "When someone's off, others know what's outstanding.",
        "We have a clear way of capturing decisions and actions.",
        "Nothing important depends on a conversation only I remember." ] },
  { name:"Time & capacity",
    blurb:"Where your hours actually go versus where they should.",
    q:[ "My time goes on the work only I can do, not general admin.",
        "I'm rarely the bottleneck holding other people up.",
        "I can see where my week actually goes.",
        "I have capacity to work on the business, not just in it.",
        "Busy periods don't mean everything else grinds to a halt." ] },
  { name:"Resilience & continuity",
    blurb:"What would happen if a key person — or you — stepped away.",
    q:[ "If a key person left, the business would keep running.",
        "Important knowledge isn't trapped in one person's head.",
        "We could lose our biggest client without the whole thing wobbling.",
        "There's some kind of plan for when things go wrong.",
        "The business isn't wholly dependent on me being in the middle of it." ] },
];
const OPTS=[["1","Strongly disagree"],["2","Disagree"],["3","Neither"],["4","Agree"],["5","Strongly agree"]];

const BANDS=[
  { min:40,  max:95,  tag:"Running on you",
    verdict:"Right now the business mostly works because you're in the middle of it, holding the moving parts together. That's not a failure — it's how nearly every owner-led business starts. But it means the ceiling on the business is your own capacity, and the cost is paid in evenings, weekends and the holidays you don't quite take. The good news: almost everything pulling on you here is structural, and structure can be built." },
  { min:96, max:150, tag:"Holding together",
    verdict:"There's real structure in places — you've clearly built some of this deliberately. But it's uneven. Some areas run themselves; others still route back through you the moment things get busy. This is the stage where a few targeted fixes make a disproportionate difference, because you're not starting from scratch — you're closing specific gaps." },
  { min:151, max:200, tag:"Built to run",
    verdict:"This is a business with proper foundations under it. The knowledge lives in the business rather than only in your head, and it could cope with you stepping back. The work from here is less about building structure and more about protecting it as you grow — making sure the next stage doesn't quietly recreate the old dependencies." },
];

/* ============================================================
   ENGINE
   ============================================================ */
let cur=0, LAST_RESULT=null;
const answers = SECTIONS.map(s=>Array(s.q.length).fill(null));

function start(){ document.getElementById('intro').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('quiz').classList.remove('hidden'); cur=0; render(); window.scrollTo(0,0); }

function render(){
  const s=SECTIONS[cur];
  const quiz=document.getElementById('quiz'); quiz.classList.remove('fade'); void quiz.offsetWidth; quiz.classList.add('fade');
  document.getElementById('stepLabel').textContent=`Section ${cur+1} of 8`;
  document.getElementById('barFill').style.width=((cur)/SECTIONS.length*100)+'%';
  quiz.querySelector('.sec-title').textContent=s.name;
  quiz.querySelector('.sec-blurb').textContent=s.blurb;
  const box=document.getElementById('questions'); box.innerHTML='';
  s.q.forEach((text,qi)=>{
    const opts=OPTS.map(([v,l])=>`
      <label><input type="radio" name="q${qi}" value="${v}" ${answers[cur][qi]==v?'checked':''}
        onchange="pick(${qi},${v})"><span class="opt"><b>${v}</b>${l}</span></label>`).join('');
    box.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',
      `<div class="q"><p>${qi+1}. ${text}</p><div class="scale">${opts}</div></div>`);
  });
  document.getElementById('backBtn').style.visibility = cur===0?'hidden':'visible';
  document.getElementById('nextBtn').textContent = cur===SECTIONS.length-1?'See my result →':'Next →';
  checkComplete();
}
function pick(qi,v){ answers[cur][qi]=v; checkComplete(); }
function checkComplete(){ document.getElementById('nextBtn').disabled = answers[cur].some(a=>a===null); }
function back(){ if(cur>0){cur--; render(); window.scrollTo(0,0);} }
function next(){ if(answers[cur].some(a=>a===null))return;
  if(cur<SECTIONS.length-1){cur++; render(); window.scrollTo(0,0);} else finish(); }

function finish(){
  const secScores=answers.map(a=>a.reduce((t,v)=>t+Number(v),0));
  const total=secScores.reduce((t,v)=>t+v,0);
  const band=BANDS.find(b=>total>=b.min&&total<=b.max)||BANDS[BANDS.length-1];
  const weakIdx=secScores.indexOf(Math.min(...secScores));
  LAST_RESULT={ total, band:band.tag, weakest:SECTIONS[weakIdx].name, sections:secScores };

  document.getElementById('quiz').classList.add('hidden');
  const r=document.getElementById('results'); r.classList.remove('hidden'); r.classList.add('fade'); window.scrollTo(0,0);

  document.getElementById('bandTag').textContent=band.tag;
  document.getElementById('verdict').textContent=band.verdict;
  document.getElementById('ctaBtn').href=DISCOVERY_CALL_URL;

  // animate ring + number
  const circ=540, off=circ-(total/200)*circ;
  setTimeout(()=>{ document.getElementById('ringFill').style.transition='stroke-dashoffset 1.4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)';
    document.getElementById('ringFill').style.strokeDashoffset=off; },150);
  let n=0; const step=Math.max(1,Math.round(total/45));
  const t=setInterval(()=>{ n=Math.min(total,n+step); document.getElementById('scoreNum').textContent=n; if(n>=total)clearInterval(t); },28);

  // per-section bars
  const rows=document.getElementById('rows'); rows.innerHTML='';
  SECTIONS.forEach((s,i)=>{
    const pct=secScores[i]/25*100;
    const col = secScores[i]<=12 ? '#C2BCDD' : secScores[i]<=19 ? '#8FCDCD' : '#4C4C52';
    rows.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',
      `<div class="row ${i===weakIdx?'weak':''}">
        <div class="top"><span class="n">${s.name}</span><span class="v">${secScores[i]}/25</span></div>
        <div class="track"><span style="background:${col}"></span></div>
      </div>`);
    setTimeout(()=>{ rows.querySelectorAll('.track span')[i].style.width=pct+'%'; },250+i*90);
  });

  document.getElementById('weakNote').innerHTML=
    `Your softest area is <strong>${SECTIONS[weakIdx].name.toLowerCase()}</strong>. `+
    `That's usually the best place to start — not because it's a failing, but because it's where a bit of structure buys back the most time. If you'd like a second pair of eyes on it, that's exactly what a discovery call is for.`;

  document.getElementById('emailMsg').dataset.default='1';
}

function submitLead(){
  const input=document.getElementById('email');
  const msg=document.getElementById('emailMsg');
  const btn=document.getElementById('sendBtn');
  const val=(input.value||'').trim();
  if(!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(val)){ msg.textContent="That email doesn't look quite right — mind checking it?"; msg.style.color="#8A6A8A"; return; }
  const payload={ email:val, score:LAST_RESULT.total, band:LAST_RESULT.band,
    weakest:LAST_RESULT.weakest, sections:LAST_RESULT.sections.join(","), date:new Date().toISOString() };
  btn.disabled=true; btn.textContent="Sending…";
  sendLead(payload).then(()=>{
    document.getElementById('emailField').innerHTML=
      '<p style="color:var(--teal);font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:1.1rem">Lovely — that\u2019s on its way. Check your inbox shortly.</p>';
  }).catch(()=>{
    btn.disabled=false; btn.textContent="Try again";
    msg.textContent="Something went wrong sending that. Give it another go in a moment."; msg.style.color="#8A6A8A";
  });
}
function restart(){ answers.forEach(a=>a.fill(null)); cur=0;
  document.getElementById('results').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('intro').classList.remove('hidden'); window.scrollTo(0,0); }
</script>
</body>
</html>
